services.desc: All groups with participants under the age of 18 must be accompanied by a ticketed parent or guardian for the duration of the game No children under 5 are permitted Left to your own devices and curiosity gnawing, can you solve your way through the room to make your way into the forbidden and very mysterious employee's only lounge? Difficulty

services.name: Escape From Oz
services.desc: All groups with participants under the age of 18 must be accompanied by a ticketed parent or guardian for the duration of the game No children under 5 are permitted You are part of the Gale family in Kansas, you find yourself trapped inside of your auntie's home with a tornado on the horizon. You bump your head and wakeup not knowing where you are and what you're going to do next, but no one else is around the house. One things for sure... You're not in Kansas anymore! So follow the Yellow Brick Road, find the keys to the Emerald City and get yourself back because there's no place like home! Difficulty

services.name: Forbidden Sands: Search for the Lamp
services.desc: All groups with participants under the age of 18 must be accompanied by a ticketed parent or guardian for the duration of the game No children under 5 are permitted The evil vizier has taken over town, and with no one to stop him you will need to step up to the job! You've heard rumblings of a magical genie sealed in a lamp that will grant you three wishes if you can get to it. The problem is, you're not sure where it is! Follow the clues, find the lamp, and save the village! Difficulty
